operators.source: packs/be/grid.json: sibelga, whose EAN codes all start with 5414489 (sibelga.be, page EAN code).

settlement.source: The proportional key of the sharing_example engine worked by hand: at each hour the energy shared is the smaller of what the participants inject and what they take; each receives in proportion to its offtake and gives in proportion to its injection. At 11:00 the flats take 11 kWh and the roof injects 9.5: flat A receives 9.5 × 5/11, flat B 9.5 × 6/11.

kpis.source: 15 kWh taken less what the key shared to flat A.
